questions.questionTextEn: Full form of NITI Aayog is
questions.explanation: Full form of NITI Aayog is National Institution for Transforming India. NITI Aayog (National Institute for Transforming India) is a new institution formed by the Government of India to replace the Planning Commission. On January 1, 2015, a Cabinet resolution giving information regarding this new institute was issued. The institute serves as a think tank of the government and provides directive and policy impetus to it. NITI Aayog provides relevant substantive and technical advice to the Government at the Central and State levels on key policy issues. This would include matters relating to national and international imports on the economic front, dissemination of best practices within the country as well as from other countries, assimilation of new policy ideas and support based on specific themes. Shri BVR Subramaniam was appointed as the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of NITI Aayog on 25 February 2023.
